title: Concept: Set-Cookie uses SameSite=None without the Partitioned attribute
description: SameSite=None without Partitioned allows a stored cookie to be replayed in any third-party embedding context, and it is shared between those contexts rather than scoped to the embedding top-level site.
applicability: Responses that set a cookie with SameSite=None.
risk: A third-party embedter of the site reuses the same cookie jar identity across unrelated top-level sites, which enables cross-site correlation; LOW because the cookie still needs to be sent in an embedding context.
